description: Inspect CPIC allele function, evidence, definition metadata and complete population frequencies for geneSymbol. Name matches literally first, then a matching gene prefix before a star allele may be removed; clinicalFunctionalStatus matches literal text case-insensitively. Discover genes with pgx_list_reference. Definitions are metadata, not variant interpretation. Frequencies are source fractions; inferred frequencies are not observations and do not establish individual risk. Pages have a 24,000-byte complete-result soft budget; an indivisible exception sets oversizedRow. Continue with page.nextOffset.

clinicalFunctionalStatus.description: Case-insensitive literal source clinical functional status; blank means unset.

geneSymbol.description: Gene symbol, such as CYP2C19 or HLA-B; outer whitespace is ignored.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice (default 25).

name.description: Exact source allele name; blank means unset.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use nextOffset to continue (default 0).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_selector`: A required selector is blank after normalization. `query_too_broad`: An internal bounded scan or attempt budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC rate limits requests. `upstream_unavailable`: The source is unavailable or returns maintenance HTML. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

activityvalue.description: Source allele activity-score descriptor; distinct from total diplotype activity score.

allele_definition.description: Full source allele definition, null, or omitted.

citations.description: Source text list in original order; nullable or absent.

frequency.description: Source population-to-frequency fractions, null, or omitted.

populationFrequencies.description: Complete matching population-frequency rows; empty when unavailable.

truncated.description: Whether more matching rows remain after this page.
